Package be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities

package be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities
Abstract entity hierarchy shared by all game objects.

Every game object derives from Entity, which defines position, size, and the abstract update/render contract. The abstract subclasses Tower, Enemy, Projectile (with RayProjectile and CannonProjectile) and Base capture shared behaviour; concrete logic lives in the towers/enemies packages and the visual implementations in j2d.entities.
